chunks: And those of the left hand — how (unhappy) those of the left hand —

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ: People of the Left Hand (those receiving their deeds in the left hand)

ai.seo_question: Who are the People of the Left Hand in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Shimal* (the Left) as a metaphor for those who turned away from the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing their spiritual deviation. The rhetorical question underscores the severity of their fate, contrasting them with the *Ahl al-Yamin* (People of the Right Hand) who are granted success through adherence to divine truth. This distinction serves as a practical reminder for believers to align their deeds with the teachings of the Imams to avoid being counted among the left-handed.
